headline: Moroccan Solar Firm Jet Energy Jumps 20% on Market Debut
summary: Moroccan solar contractor Jet Energy rose 19.97% on its first day of trading in Casablanca. The IPO was oversubscribed 31.4 times and raised $37.6 million.
why: Strong IPO performance in the renewable energy sector reflects investor appetite for green infrastructure projects.
